inputs.text: [serious][softly] Sixty-six million years ago, something huge, huge, huge happened. [pauses] The big dinosaurs disappeared. All of them. Why? [curious] Scientists found the answer: a GIANT meteorite, as big as a mountain, came crashing down from the sky. [pauses] Boom! Right into Mexico.

[softly][confident] As big as an entire MOUNTAIN! [pauses] But listen: this happened a very, very long time ago, [curious] way before you, way before your great-great-grandparents. [amazed] And you know what? Life has always found a way to carry on.
